_readme: Per-family language-engine configuration, keyed by family root id. A family listed here gets a generated language at every node; families not listed are shown as 'no language defined'. Everything is derived from these settings plus the family's own language names — no word forms are stored. Delete a family's entry to switch it off.

proto-dahen-kino.name: Dahen-Kino
notes: Character (DJ, 13 Oct 2026): Sinitic. SVO and isolating are declared here; everything else the engine infers. Evidence is its language names only: its phonology passed DJ's review from them, and its Massir city names (Gorlatki, Czarnulek, Pavroshka) look Slavic and would pull it away from the Sinitic goal. category:deletion 2 wears its words towards Sinitic monosyllables, which is what makes tone and disyllabic compounds arise.

drift: Dahen-Kino is the Sinitic family (DJ, 13 Oct 2026: its Sinitic goal stands), so its lineages lean towards tonogenesis and rarely give tone up once they have it. Every other tendency is drawn by the engine.

standardisedAt: the year the family was first written in a standard form, after which spelling stops tracking pronunciation (English writes 'knight' for /naɪt/). Dahen-Kino's is the wiki's (the Dehlan script standardisation, 207 BFA); the engine draws the others from each family's record (DJ, 17 Oct 2026: 'engine draws per family'). Set one here to fix it.

Laryngeal: the modern names show an aspiration contrast (Qai, Zhao, Xia read as Pinyin), so the proto is reconstructed BEHIND them with a voicing contrast that later split the tones and then devoiced — the Middle Chinese pattern.
Stress is final because the daughters include monosyllables (Qai, Qi, Xia, Chu, Shie, Hah, Wan, Min): final stress starves the syllables before it and collapses disyllables into monosyllables.
/ʂ/ is withheld and /ɻ/ reconstructed as *r — retroflexion is treated as a daughter innovation, as it is in every reconstruction of Old Chinese.
Doubled vowels in the names (Kaastini, Siaa, Zaahr) are a spelling quirk, not length. Length has to be earned later, by compensatory lengthening when a coda is lost.
proto-dahen-kino.consonantTargetNote: Sinitic (DJ, 13 Oct 2026): Mandarin has about 22 consonants, Cantonese 19, Middle Chinese more; kept out of the thinning by hand.
proto-dahen-kino.standardisedAtBy: wiki: Dahe (the Dehlan standardisation of the Dahen script, 207 BFA)

_provisional_note: The five families below are PROVISIONAL and untuned. They exist so that a change made for Dahen-Kino can be measured against families it must not damage — tuning six shared catalogue templates against a sample of one is overfitting whatever shape the code takes. Every setting here is an engine default, not a lore decision: the transcription reading is auto-detected from each family's own names, stress is the cross-linguistic default, and no segments are withheld. DJ should review each of these at the same two gates Dahen-Kino went through (mined profile, then proto spec) before treating any of the output as canon.

proto-alzuria-ayuman.name: Alzuria-Ayuman
classicalNote: PROVISIONAL, and the only family that has one — deliberately, so that the five without it are the control. Delete this block and the family reverts exactly.

Ancient Misosn (born -450, 20 descendants) stands as this family's written ancestor, the way Latin does for Romance and Sanskrit for Indo-Aryan. Its descendants take words back out of it from year 100 onward, once every 500 years.

The effect is doublets: a word inherited through ordinary speech alongside the same word lifted off the page centuries later, worn by none of the sound changes in between — French frêle beside fragile, both Latin fragilem. That stratum is also the family's formal register.
Which stage was written down is a LORE decision, not an engine one. This is a plausible placeholder and DJ should choose the real one.
proto-alzuria-ayuman.consonantTargetNote: Claude's pick, 15 Oct 2026 (DJ: "you pick"): the big canon families stay near what their names use, the small ones go Polynesian-sized, so the families together come near Earth's spread (WALS 1A). Change freely.
